title: Recover heat of dissolution
statement:
A salt dissolves and cools its insulated coffee-cup solution from 25.0 to 21.0 °C. Neglect cup heat. Which sign applies to dissolution?

[_]{a}

choices: The sign cannot be determined under the stated conditions.
explanations: This is the sign for the cooling solution.
The energy balance determines the sign.

hints: Assign the temperature change to the solution.
Determine the sign of solution heat.
solution: The solution loses sensible heat as it cools: $q_\mathrm{solution}<0$. The dissolution process absorbs that heat.
